issue.title: Router rejects Unicode path segment
issue.body: A percent-encoded Unicode username in /users/<name> returns 404 although the user exists.

candidates.title: Unicode usernames disappear in logs
candidates.body: The logging formatter drops non-ASCII characters.

candidates.title: Non-ASCII profile URL 404
candidates.body: A percent-encoded Unicode username causes /users/<name> to return 404 for an existing user.
